notes.title: Gameplay Patch: Boss Balancing & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Time for some fine-tuning! This patch focuses on enemy and combat balancing and bug fixes. Check out the changes below:


[h3]Boss balancing[/h3]
After improving the roll mechanic and fixing the cheap stunlock issue in the previous patch, I noticed that this trivializes some boss fights, making them way easier than they should be. This patch balances that out, and now your boss battles will be more intense, but also much more engaging and fun!

[h3]Added an additional checkpoint in Level 2[/h3]
I've seen some complaints about the lack of a checkpoint in the first area of Level 2. If you die after collecting all the power cells, you have to recollect them all over again. This patch addresses that frustration by saving your progress when you use the power cells to disintegrate a barrier to the next area.

[h3]Minor environmental improvements[/h3]
I fixed some graphical issues, including misplaced decals, and improved collision instances on certain objects. These changes may seem subtle, but they'll enhance your overall experience!

[h3]Increased speed of some drones in Level 2[/h3]
You raised some issues about a couple of drones in Level 2 being too slow, making it tedious to wait for their spotlights to go away. Now they are faster, and you won't have to wait as long!

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
There are some reported gameplay bugs that are fixed in this patch, most notably the bug where you fall through a conveyor belt in specific cases in Level 3. I don't want you to develop a conveyor belt phobia, so I took care of that!

Thank you for all your feedback, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Gameplay patch!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

It was a joy seeing you try the game for the first time! I'm happy you liked the game, and I'm very grateful for your feedback on how I can further improve it!

This is the first gameplay patch, where I addressed the following issues:

[h3]Improved Dodge Roll[/h3]
The number one complaint about the game was that the dodge roll mechanic felt unfair, as you could still take damage while rolling. I have fixed the dodge roll invincibility frames, making your rolls much more satisfying!

[h3]Addressed Cheap Stunlock Moments[/h3]
I hear you loud and clear! Being stunlocked to death by enemy combos or overwhelmed by groups of katana-wielding angry robots is not cool. Now, with sufficient stamina, you will have a better opportunity to roll away to safety. This change promotes fair and engaging combat. However, remember that it doesn't mean you can rush headlessly into danger!

[h3]Balanced Stamina, Health, and Damage[/h3]
This patch includes adjustments to health and damage values, preventing individual enemy fights from becoming tedious. Additionally, your stamina will now recharge faster, and you'll enjoy a slight increase in sprinting speed!

[h3]Fixed Visual Jitter on Elevated Platforms[/h3]
In the initial version of the game, an unsightly visual glitch occurred when the player character briefly 'flashed' while stepping on elevated platforms like sidewalks or stairs. I have resolved this issue, and the visual jitter is now eliminated!

[h3]Improved Vital Strike[/h3]
Previously, the Vital Strike (critical attack) could only be performed on locked-on enemies, which proved to be a poor decision. I have made a significant improvement: now you can perform Vital Strikes on any enemy, even multiple at once, regardless of whether you are locked onto them or not!

[h3]Revised Tutorial Phone Booths[/h3]
I noticed that some players overlooked the tutorial phone booths that provide control information. To enhance visibility, I have strategically relocated them, ensuring you won't miss them this time!

[h3]Fixed Dialogue Display Bugs[/h3]
Some instances of dialogue were displayed outside the dialogue boxes, causing readability issues. I have revised the dialogue display to ensure that all dialogue is properly contained within the boxes.



That's all for now! Thank you once again for helping me improve Lifespace Traveler. I highly appreciate all your feedback! Enjoy the game. :)

notes.notes:
Lifespace Traveler is an action-packed, easy to learn, hard to master cyberpunk game where reality is split into dimensions called Lifespaces. No hand holding. No mercy. Fight your way and test your reflexes in fast-paced, brutal combat as you reveal the mysteries of an unforgiving dystopian world.

Hi there! I'm Dino Trnka, creator of Lifespace Traveler. I will be playing and live streaming the game, so if you're up to some hack and slash action, come and watch me play!
